critical_code_review_comments: invite/redeem accepts only `password` (no confirmation match server-side) — frontend correctly enforces Confirm Password client-side, which is acceptable since password is hashed server-side.
send_sms returns False on any exception and does not raise — audit log correctly skipped for failed SMS. Friday reminder still logs REMINDER_FRIDAY email even if SMS fails (verified).
Integration status endpoint correctly admin-gated (403 for non-admin) and exposes only non-sensitive metadata (no API keys, no auth token in response).
Dashboard trend reverses chronologically after sort(-1) + reverse() — confirmed ordered ascending by week_start.

Audit filter uses Mongo $regex with $options:'i' on `detail` — case-insensitive substring as documented; injects raw user input — consider escaping regex special chars (low priority since field is auth-scoped to user_id).
password_resets stores expires_at as BSON datetime (timezone-aware UTC) and reset-password parses both BSON datetime and ISO string for backward-compat — correct.
TTL index `expires_at` with expireAfterSeconds=0 created on startup for password_resets and invites — verified via pymongo index_information().
Invite expires_at uses BSON datetime (timedelta+timezone.utc) — TTL cleanup will auto-purge old invites.
Resend `send_email` falls back from custom domain to onboarding@resend.dev on first exception — friday reminder still delivers.
